label: W6-2
reason: Stage 2: no closed regular language yet. An exact collector shows that the junction words more than 20 cells from the head form a tiny alphabet. Left of the head: 3, 10, 310, 1023, 3210, 0. Right of the head: 120, 40, 300, 50, 310, 0, plus the counter end. It is complete by step 2.1e6 and unchanged to 1e10. Every 111 sits in the junction 300, whose 3 turns a right run. Closures with fixed junction languages (exact 12-30-cell zone, free order, segment-length classes) still escape after 10^2-10^4 configurations: they build orders and short-segment neighbours that the orbit never builds. No halt to 1.55e11. Not a cryptid (no halting branch); stuck on tooling.
